title: On Advocating a slower way of working
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：advocate　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 advocate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the grower ① advocated a slower way of working at once, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three summers on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grower ② advocates a slower way of working in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ advocate a slower way of working at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ advocated a slower way of working before — a line in the ledger for August 1951 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Advocating a slower way of working at once, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ advocate the return of the old rules in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Advocate the return of the old rules at once and never mention it again.

By 1964 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new buyer from the next greenhouse ⑧ advocates the return of the old rules at once every summer without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ advocated a slower way of working again when nobody else would.

⑩ To advocate a slower way of working, my mother said in 1969, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the greenhouse remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the greenhouse forgets, somebody advocates a slower way of working in the rain again and somebody must advocate a slower way of working at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 提倡（一般过去式 advocated a slower way of working：1957 年种植户头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 提倡（一般现在 advocates a slower way of working：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 提倡（不定式 to advocate a slower way of working：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 提倡（过去完成时 had advocated a slower way of working：1951 年八月的收成账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 提倡（动名词 advocating a slower way of working 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 主张（advocate the return of the old rules：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去主张恢复那些旧规矩）
G. v. 主张（advocate the return of the old rules：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 提倡（后段两处：新来的收购人照例 advocates the return of the old rules，而母亲又一次 advocated a slower way of working）

answers.why: advocate 意为“提倡”，1957 年种植户二话不说地提倡慢一点的做事方式，那是大棚里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 advocated。
advocate 意为“提倡”，自那以后种植户淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 advocates。
advocate 意为“提倡”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯提倡慢一点的做事方式”，此处为不定式 to advocate a slower way of working。
advocate 意为“提倡”，收成账里 八月 那行字说明早在 1964 年之前就有人提倡过，故用过去完成时 had advocated。
advocate 意为“提倡”，种植户说“提倡慢一点的做事方式这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 advocating a slower way of working 作主语。
advocate 意为“主张”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去主张恢复那些旧规矩”，should ever 之后用原形 advocate the return of the old rules。
advocate 意为“主张”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻主张恢复那些旧规矩（advocate the return of the old rules at once），以后再也不要提起。
advocate 意为“提倡”，新来的收购人每个夏天都照例主张恢复那些旧规矩，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 advocates。
advocate 意为“提倡”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地提倡慢一点的做事方式，用一般过去式 advocated 叙述。
advocate 意为“提倡”，结尾那句是母亲 1969 年的话：要提倡慢一点的做事方式，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和大棚记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，种植户二话不说地提倡慢一点的做事方式；大棚里每一个收购人都说这是头一回。（advocated a slower way of working）
多年以后，种植户仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（advocates a slower way of working）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯提倡慢一点的做事方式这件事本身。（to advocate a slower way of working）
早在 1951 年就有人提倡慢一点的做事方式，八月那天收成账上的一行字就是证据。（had advocated a slower way of working）
种植户说过，二话不说地提倡慢一点的做事方式这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（advocating a slower way of working 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻主张恢复那些旧规矩，以后再也不要提起。（advocate the return of the old rules，祈使句）
answers: In 1957 the grower advocated a slower way of working at once, and every buyer in the greenhouse said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three summers on, the grower still advocates a slower way of working in the rain without being asked.
My mother said later that to advocate a slower way of working at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had advocated a slower way of working long before 1964, and the line in the ledger for August proves it.
Advocating a slower way of working at once, the grower said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Advocate the return of the old rules at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 advocate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the grower advocated a slower way of working at once, and nobody in the greenhouse forgot it.
Even now the grower advocates a slower way of working in the rain whenever the greenhouse asks.
Advocating a slower way of working at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever advocate the return of the old rules in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next greenhouse advocates the return of the old rules at once every summer, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother advocated a slower way of working again, and the greenhouse remembered that half.
